FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What type of work is involved?

The project is described as handwriting work on A4-size sheets. Review the exact assignment and quality requirements before starting.

Is the payout guaranteed?

No website should present an income figure as guaranteed without enforceable written terms. Check the official agreement and eligibility conditions before relying on any payout figure.

What is the registration fee?

The fee depends on the selected package and is shown on each project card. Confirm the current fee before payment.

Can I get support before payment?

Yes. Use the contact section to ask questions and verify the project, payment recipient and terms before paying.
